title: The Elder's Truth
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II, Episode 5: The Elder's Truth. After the drum, the Keeper finally asks the question he has never asked: who are you? And the Elder tells him everything. At the beginning there were three keepers, and the world was quiet — a note cannot complete itself, so we gave them ours. That is what a keeper is: not one who has a song, but one who gives his own away. Every night you walked home with empty hands, because you had already given them. The first of us gave his note too — and then he wanted it back, and took it anyway. The place where his note had been became the first silence; we called him the Sunderer. The ones who followed did the same, and kept nothing. That is why the dark wears a keeper's shadow. It was one. And the light you found in the grass — I left it there. It was mine. I gave you mine, so that you would have one to give.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #lore #storytelling
